pairs: Anno autem quintodecimo imperii Tiberii Cæsaris,
in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar,
Pontius Pilate being procurator of Judea,
Philippo autem fratre ejus tetrarcha Iturææ,
and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis,
sub principibus sacerdotum Anna et Caipha:
under the high priests Annas and Caiaphas:
factum est verbum Domini super Joannem,
the word of the Lord came to John,
Et venit in omnem regionem Jordanis,
And he went into the entire region of the Jordan,
prædicans baptismum pœnitentiæ in remissionem peccatorum,
preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins,
sicut scriptum est in libro sermonum Isaiæ prophetæ:
just as it has been written in the book of the sermons of the prophet Isaiah:
“The voice of one crying out in the wilderness:
Prepare the way of the Lord.
and hill shall be brought low.
And what is crooked shall be made straight.
And the rough paths shall be made into level ways.
et videbit omnis caro salutare Dei.
And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.”
Dicebat ergo ad turbas quæ exibant ut baptizarentur ab ipso:
Therefore, he said to the crowd that went out in order to be baptized by him:
quis ostendit vobis fugere a ventura ira?
Who told you to flee from the approaching wrath?
So then, produce fruits worthy of repentance.
And do not begin to say,
Dico enim vobis quia potens est Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrahæ.
For I tell you that God has the power to raise up sons to Abraham from these stones.
Jam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est.
For even now the axe has been placed at the root of the trees.
Omnis ergo arbor non faciens fructum bonum,
every tree that does not produce good fruit shall be cut down
And the crowed was questioning him,
But in response, he said to them:
Qui habet duas tunicas, det non habenti:
“Whoever has two coats, let him give to those who do not have.
Venerunt autem et publicani ut baptizarentur,
Now the tax collectors also came to be baptized,
Nihil amplius, quam quod constitutum est vobis, faciatis.
“You should do nothing more than what has been appointed to you.”
Then the soldiers also questioned him,
and you should not make false accusations.
And be content with your pay.”
Now all were thinking about John in their hearts,
et cogitantibus omnibus in cordibus suis de Joanne, ne forte ipse esset Christus,
and the people were supposing that perhaps he might be the Christ.
John responded by saying to everyone:
But there will arrive one stronger than me,
cujus non sum dignus solvere corrigiam calceamentorum ejus:
the laces of whose shoes I am not worthy to loosen.
ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto
He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit,
His winnowing fan is in his hand.
And he will purify his threshing floor.
et congregabit triticum in horreum suum,
And he will gather the wheat into the barn.
But the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire.”
Multa quidem et alia exhortans evangelizabat populo.
Indeed, he also proclaimed many other things, exhorting the people.
Herodes autem tetrarcha cum corriperetur ab illo de Herodiade uxore fratris sui,
But Herod the tetrarch, when he was corrected by him concerning Herodias, his brother’s wife,
et de omnibus malis quæ fecit Herodes,
and concerning all the evils that Herod had done,
that he confined John to prison.
Factum est autem cum baptizaretur omnis populus,
Now it happened that, when all the people were being baptized,
and as he was praying, heaven was opened.
et descendit Spiritus Sanctus corporali specie sicut columba in ipsum:
And the Holy Spirit, in a corporal appearance like a dove, descended upon him.
et vox de cælo facta est:
And a voice came from heaven:
“You are my beloved Son. In you,
Et ipse Jesus erat incipiens quasi annorum triginta,
And Jesus himself was beginning to be about thirty years old,
being (as it was supposed) the son of Joseph,
